thread:
sam: Uploaded weights to s3://redwood-models/warpnet/v2/2026-03-01/sha256:fa3b... Can someone confirm tokenizer files are correct? I see vocab.json and merges.txt but tokenizer_config.json has do_lower_case=true which worries me. Need a canary plan + region enablement (us-west1 + eu-central1).

taylor: @sam i'll pull the bundle and check the tokenizer mapping. do you want raw uri or staged path?

sam: raw URI above. listing shows: weights.bin, vocab.json, merges.txt, tokenizer_config.json, config.json

priya: tokenizer_config.json currently: {"do_lower_case": true} — that seems off if model was trained cased. can you paste the file?

sam: pasted config below:
```json
{"do_lower_case": true, "bos_token": "<s>", "eos_token": "</s>"}
```
I think it was supposed to be false.

lee: Changing tokenizer semantics post-training will break token alignment. We should ship the exact tokenizer from the training run. Option: set a serving override like preserve_case: true so the runtime doesn't apply lowercasing.

sam: Proposed serving config (for validation):
```yaml
model:
  id: warpnet-v2
  version: "v2.0.0-rc1"
  weights_uri: "s3://redwood-models/warpnet/v2/2026-03-01/weights.bin"
  tokenizer:
    vocab: "s3://redwood-models/warpnet/v2/2026-03-01/vocab.json"
    merges: "s3://redwood-models/warpnet/v2/2026-03-01/merges.txt"
    preserve_case: true
routing:
  canary:
    percent: 10
    regions: ["us-west1"]
  fallback_variants: ["warpnet-v2-quant", "warpnet-v1"]
```

taylor: LGTM from config perspective. quick validation: can someone run tokenizer tests on a prod-like corpus before we open the canary? @lee?

lee: running the tokenizer harness now. quick note: the lowercasing flag is present in tokenizer_config.json and is being picked up by our loader; i'll override locally and run through the sample dataset.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment request received for warpnet-v2 v2.0.0-rc1. Canary spec: 10% traffic in us-west1. Jobs queued => job_id: cj-8921. Estimated completion: ~12m.

priya: For eu-central1 enablement we need an infra ticket (security groups + regional quota). I'll open one and CC platform infra.

sam: I'll hold on broader rollout until we confirm tokenizer override is baked into the package and canary passes smoke tests. Also want explicit fallback mapping if the quantized variant is incompatible.

taylor: pinging code review @sam — small loader change to respect preserve_case flag. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/2345

sam: reviewed and left comments. added unit tests for tokenization edgecases (emoji + uppercase acronyms).

lee: local tokenizer run results: with preserve_case=true tokens align with training set for 99.3% samples; with do_lower_case=true there are clear mismatches at sentence starts and proper nouns. I'll push a small patch to ignore tokenizer_config.do_lower_case in favor of preserve_case when model metadata indicates cased training.

deploy-bot: job cj-8921 completed. Canary live. health checks: OK. p50 latency (us-west1): 82ms. errors: 0.3%.

sam: Monitoring evaluation runs against our benchmark prompts show a couple of low-prob hallucinations on the v2 canary set. Lowering canary to 5% while we investigate. ETA ~30m.

lee: looking at logs — hallucinations correlate with tokens at sentence boundaries where casing+emoji interactions happen. pushing a tokenizer patch to handle `PATTERN: ^[A-Z]` + emoji sequences.

priya: Once patch is validated, we'll reopen canary to 25% and then schedule eu-central1 onboarding (ticket created: INFRA-4862). I'll attach cost and latency estimates there.

taylor: :thumbsup:

sam: thanks everyone. I'll update this thread after the next deploy and final rollout decision.
